# Zero Mouse Clicks

> Free, open-source web tool that turns the floor plan image from a developer's brochure or a real-estate listing into an architectural plan set: eight A3 drawing sheets in one PDF. Three tiny segmentation models read the image and explicit rules draw it, entirely in the visitor's browser (no upload, no LLM, no tokens).

The plan set contains: G-001 cover and index, A-101 floor plan with dimensions and room areas, A-102 area, finish, door and window schedules, A-103 floor finishes, A-104 schematic electrical layout, A-105 furniture layout, A-201 kitchen section and A-202 bathroom section. Scale comes from the room dimensions printed on the plan or from the declared area (m² or sq ft). It is an early prototype: marketing plans are not to scale, sections and electrical points are assumptions, and every sheet says to verify dimensions on site. Licence: Apache-2.0 (code and model weights).

## Pages

- [Tool](https://zeromouseclicks.com/): drop a floor plan image, get the plan set PDF
- [How it works](https://zeromouseclicks.com/how-it-works): models, scale from printed dimensions, rules, limitations
- [The plan set](https://zeromouseclicks.com/plan-set): what each of the eight sheets contains
- [FAQ](https://zeromouseclicks.com/faq): price, privacy, accuracy, file formats, devices
